scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a relaxed Marseille-and-Cassis trip, [X] and two friends choose a compact day carrier that can move from a breezy coastal walk and crowded harbor to seafood lunch and one nicer dinner without requiring a second bag.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为节奏轻松的马赛与卡西斯旅行收拾行李时，[X]和两位朋友需要选择一只小巧日用包，使它能从海风较强的海岸步行、拥挤港口一路用到海鲜午餐和一顿较正式的晚餐，而无需再带第二只包。
examples: using Casual or Sporty when daytime walking and hands-free movement dominate
using Classic or Elegant when the same carrier must remain appropriate at dinner
using Modern or Minimalist when one restrained design has to bridge all settings

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a birthday present for a mother who takes regular walks, [X] compares a small backpack and tote against her casual wardrobe, favorite color, everyday essentials, and a budget below seventy euros so the gift feels personal rather than merely practical.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为经常散步的母亲挑选生日礼物时，[X]把小背包和托特包与母亲的休闲衣着、偏爱颜色、日常随身物品以及 70 欧元以内预算放在一起比较，希望礼物既实用又有个人意味。
examples: using Casual or Sporty when the regular walking routine defines the look
using Classic when the gift should age well with her existing wardrobe
using Cute only through an affectionate detail that does not make the bag juvenile

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a summer trip through Italian cities, [X] chooses a zippered crossbody that suits comfortable chic clothing while remaining secure through cobblestone walks, church visits, sustainable shopping, crowded transit, and a nicer dinner.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利城市夏季行程挑选带拉链的斜挎包时，[X]要求它既适合舒适又利落的衣着，也能安全应对石板路步行、教堂参观、可持续商店、拥挤交通和较正式的晚餐。
examples: using Casual or Sporty for heat, long walks, and body-close security
using Elegant or Classic when church coverage and dinner polish become active
using Modern or Minimalist when one low-profile bag must work across the route

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While refining a recurring comic character, [X] uses one worn leather satchel with mismatched repairs and a wooden-whistle marker to keep the character's village background legible against a sharper modern city across panels.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在完善一个反复登场的漫画角色时，[X]会用同一只带不同布料修补痕迹、挂有木哨标记的旧皮挎包，在多个分镜中持续表现角色的乡村背景，并与更锐利的现代城市形成对比。
examples: using Vintage or Traditional when the satchel should carry the character's village history
using Bohemian when visible mending and handmade irregularity reinforce the organic world
using Cute only through scale or the personal whistle rather than replacing the established bag

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying in Madrid, [X] compares several named laptop bags for cafes and campus, seeking enough protection for an expensive workstation while keeping the carrier visually ordinary, low-profile, and compatible with daily student clothing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在马德里学习期间，[X]会比较几款有明确品牌或型号的笔记本电脑包，希望它们既能保护昂贵的移动工作站，又在咖啡馆和校园中显得普通、低调，并能融入日常学生穿着。
examples: using Modern or Minimalist when the carrier should look technically capable but visually quiet
using Classic when the bag must remain credible across classes and more formal meetings
using Casual when ordinary lifestyle appearance is a deliberate security choice

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a dated Buenos Aires itinerary, [X] compares leather and handmade bags across a crowded Sunday market, pedestrian shops, and an upscale gallery to decide whether a purchase feels like authentic local craft and will still work after returning home.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一份有明确日期的布宜诺斯艾利斯行程中，[X]会在拥挤的周日市集、步行街商店和高档商场之间比较皮包与手作包，判断购买物是否真正体现本地工艺，并在回家后仍能继续使用。
examples: using Traditional or Bohemian when visible handwork and local craft are central
using Vintage when aged leather or established forms feel intentional rather than worn out
using Elegant or Classic when the gallery version must justify a more polished price tier

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] completes a formal and glamorous look around a floral dress, chest ruffles, platform shoes, and restrained jewelry, then chooses a compact clutch that complements the ceremony outfit without becoming another competing focal point.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为毕业场合准备造型时，[X]围绕花卉连衣裙、胸前荷叶边、厚底鞋和克制首饰完善正式而华丽的搭配，并挑选一只与典礼穿搭协调的小巧手拿包，避免再增加一个争抢注意力的焦点。
examples: using Elegant or Classic when polish and longevity matter more than novelty
using Modern when a clean compact form balances the dress volume
using Trendy only when it remains subordinate to the graduation outfit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends and a playful country-club dress theme, [X] chooses a compact crossbody that remains usable during lawn activities while looking deliberate in coordinated group photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场有 25 位高尔夫朋友参加、采用趣味乡村俱乐部着装主题的户外午宴中，[X]会挑选一只小巧斜挎包，要求它既不妨碍草坪活动，也能在统一风格的集体合影中显得协调得体。
examples: using Sporty when movement and golf references remain visible
using Elegant when the luncheon reads as polished country-club socializing
using Trendy or Casual when the group chooses a playful contemporary interpretation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a dry R&B stadium concert, [X] chooses between a policy-compliant clear crossbody and a tiny clutch that fits comfortable elevated streetwear, survives dancing and steep seating, and does not create extra friction at screening.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场天气干燥的 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]要在合规透明斜挎包和极小手拿包之间选择，使它能融入舒适而利落的街头穿搭、经得住跳舞与陡峭看台，同时不给安检增加麻烦。
examples: using Sporty or Casual when comfort and movement lead the outfit
using Trendy when the clear crossbody intentionally matches elevated streetwear
using Modern when clean hardware and a compact form preserve venue compliance

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named Swissgear laptop backpack for a fixed daily load and asks whether its protective and organizational design can still look sleek rather than bulky in a professional setting.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]会评估一款有明确型号的 Swissgear 笔记本电脑背包，在承载固定日常物品的同时，判断它的保护与整理结构能否在较正式的环境中仍显利落，而不是显得臃肿。
examples: using Modern when technical organization and clean construction are both visible
using Classic when the commuter wants a stable professional appearance
using Sporty or Minimalist only when ergonomic structure remains visually controlled
